description.text: Training Target In order to adapt to the need of further application in various fields and trades, it by means of the theory and method of modern project management, according to the examinee has professional knowledge or industry background, on the basis of cultivation of modern project management thoughts, theories and methods used in the field, of applied talents in the industry. Future Career Plan, organize, direct, coordinate, control and evaluate the whole process from the beginning of investment decision-making to the end of the project. Duration 3 years

duration.text: The Project Management at University of International Business and Economics is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 9027 USD/per year ￥ 65000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Bachelor's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4.Transcript of undergraduate school 5.Two recommendation letters(optional) From professor,associate professor or equivalents. 6.Letter of guardian’s guarantee For applicant under 18 years of age Letter of guarantee The guardian should write out his/her name, nationality, occupation and address (if an organization acts as the guardian, reference to the organization should be made clear). 7.English proficiency test certificate A copy of TOEFL 86 above or IELTS 6.0 above for major offered in English.

requirements.text: 1. Non-Chinese Citizens in good health, under the age of 35. 2. Having bachelor degree or above in related disciplines.
